compositionLaws: TigerBeetle state is mechanical accounting state and cannot establish settlement, legal ownership, venue execution state, or external-write policy.
Provider balance constraints may enforce accounting scarcity but do not authorize an external financial effect.
POST_PENDING_TRANSFER and VOID_PENDING_TRANSFER are selected from authoritative reconciliation results, not inferred from TigerBeetle balances.
Terminal local reservation history cannot be automatically reopened by stale, incomplete, restarted, or recovered provider state.
recoveryLaws: An intact TigerBeetle replica restart must reuse the same data file; it must not re-format provider history.
Permanent replica data loss is not repaired by format; TigerBeetle recover is required under a healthy cluster.
Provider state never rewrites terminal local reservation history.
A missing or stale provider terminal resolution yields no-repair/recovery standing, never automatic recreation or reopening.
Exact replay may prove provider idempotency but cannot mint Ordivon Capital Accounting/Governance authority.
